desc: Implement numpy FFT self-convolution solution: build presence array of length L=next power of two > 2*max(S), compute irfft(rfft(a)*rfft(a)), round to int64, sum (conv[2B]-1)//2 over B in S, output answer.
Verified reduction correctness (fix middle B, subtract self-pair, halve ordered pairs) and precision bound (error ~1e-8 << 0.5 for L<=2^21).
Confirmed all 3 public samples pass (3, 5, 10) and edge case N<3 returns 0.
Verified L > 2*M guarantees linear (non-circular) convolution and 2B index validity.
